candidates.description: Running local Language Language Models (LLM) to perform Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
This project aims to introduce and demonstrate the practical applications of RAG using Python code in a Jupyter Notebook environment.
Template for AI chatbots & document management using Retrieval-Augmented Generation with vector search and FastAPI.
RAG/LLM Security Scanner identifies critical vulnerabilities in AI-powered applications, including chatbots, virtual assistants, and knowledge retrieval systems.
A powerful CLI tool to manage, test, and optimize RAG pipelines. Streamline your Retrieval-Augmented Generation workflows from terminal.

A FastAPI application that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with a large language model (LLM) to create an interactive chatbot. This chatbot leverages PostgreSQL vector store for efficient document retrieval and supports text and CSV data sources for initialization.

This repository develops a RAG-powered chatbot that answers questions based on a specific PDF document. Key objectives include:  Chatbot Development: Chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Dataset Creation, Performance Evaluation
An AI-powered chatbot that answers student questions using university PDFs with the help of Google's Gemini API and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture.
LLM Chatbot w/ Retrieval Augmented Generation using Llamaindex. It demonstrates how to impl. chunking, indexing, and source citation.
